bibl.title: A Building Inscription for the Blemmyan King Kabantia.
bibl.seg: Rodney Ast, Szymon Popławski & Joanna Rądkowska, A Building Inscription for the Blemmyan King Kabantia.
bibl.note: Fifth-century building inscription found during the 2020 excavation season at Berenike on the Red Sea coast of Egypt, on the lintel of the entrance to a shrine in the harbor's so-called Northern Complex. - 1. Archeological and architectural contexts (J.R. & S.P.). - 2. The lintel inscription (R.A.): [Edition]; - Kabantia, king of the tribe of Blemmyes; - Blemmyan rulers; - Conclusion.
